title: Windows Recall snapshot store
whyItMatters: Recall saves periodic screenshots and extracted text from the screen. This folder shows how much of the user's on-screen activity was captured.
source: Microsoft Learn manage-recall: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/client-management/manage-recall ; path CoreAIPlatform.00/UKP documented by Ars Technica 2025-04-21
notes: Build: Windows 11 24H2, GA on Copilot+ PCs April 2025. Snapshot store is encrypted with Hello ESS keys from the September 2024 redesign. Folder metadata only; images and ukg.db are never opened.
